items.title: Lessons from real-shop ops → Lab OS
items.body: Audit → improve → dated proof is now a first-class Lab loop. Kept informed and finish-the-job sit on the public scorecard. Agent ops prefer action digests over closed email watches. Patterns only — no third-party manuals. See docs/lessons-from-ops.md and company.html#lab-os.

items.title: Company study applied — promo videos drafted for post-audit
items.body: Public company study of what works (first principles, delete-before-automate, founder-direct) and what we will not copy (fake scale, automate-before-delete, intensity without structure). Lab OS now includes the improvement algorithm. Promo video scripts are prepped as drafts only — publish after Ian audit. See docs/company-study-elon.md and docs/promo-videos-post-audit.md.

items.title: Lab Operating System published on Company
items.body: Company hub now carries the Lab Operating System: purpose, six-step playbook, competency language, public scorecard, learning loop, and quick-reference rule. Patterns for how durable multi-brand operators run — DTRT-owned language only. Read company.html#lab-os and docs/lab-operating-system.md.

items.title: Company foundation pages and @dtrtlab.com inbox
items.body: Public Terms, Cookies, DMCA, Brand, Careers, and Company pages are live. hello@dtrtlab.com and ian@dtrtlab.com receive mail via Cloudflare Email Routing into the founder Gmail inbox. Store and hiring remain off until they are real.
